reader.self_description: Claude (Opus 5.5) subagent reading the TJ09 join batch: read every claim card in full from join-queue.json, opened deposit text around the cited lines where context was needed (ranges under read), and copied evidence phrases by script. Search-hit lines are under located; the #49 ranges were read with long lines truncated at 200-300 characters.

sets.name: Semiotic diagnostics of the 2026 Iran war
sets.basis: Both deposits read the 2026 U.S.-Israeli war with Iran as a semiotic sequence (the February 11 Baal effigy before the strikes; the Operation Epic Fury splice videos after them) that standard coverage drops or metabolizes; distinct claims on one subject.

evidence.phrase: The semiotic prelude was dropped from the causal chain.
The war videos' debunking increases reach because the campaign optimizes for attention, not truth.

evidence.phrase: The Prince of Poets cannot be inherited because there is no prior holder.
The mantle is not inherited. It is wrought.

observations: TJ09.2: the apparent contradiction stays two claims. PRED-328.H1 ('cannot be inherited because there is no prior holder', #328, 2026-01-18) and PRED-950.G3 ('not inherited. It is wrought', #950) deny inheritance of the title, while the existing states chain PRED-950.G3 -> PRED-1656.H1 -> PRED-1681.G1 has #1656 say I Am X 'materially inherits the operation'. PRED-328.H1 is not a state of that chain (it states why the Prince has no predecessor, not the extend-the-chain test); added to the Prince of Poets wager series only.

TJ09.3, TJ09.11, TJ09.14: every claim named is already in the series the observation proposes (Theophrastus named-function model; Immanent execution: the claim, its criteria and its tests; Erasure Skew measurement programme). Nothing added. PRED-1524.G1 and PRED-1525.F1 left as claim and its test, not same.

TJ09.4: PRED-510.H2 (the statin-guideline case of the five-step deposit/cross-reference/define/bridge/maintain process, #510) is not added to 'Inward Turn phase forecasts'; it is a historical case, not a phase forecast. A later pass building a series of the Inward Turn's model and its cases could join it with PRED-106.A3 and PRED-172.A4.

TJ09.5: the Prince of Poets appearance-conditions table also stands in #332 (AXN-0088-text.md line 255, 'The Prince of Poets mantle surfaces when:') and a Good Gray Poet table in #334 (AXN-008A-text.md line 180); located by search, not checked against the claim index here. If neither is coded, they are uncoded members of 'Mantle surfacing triggers'. The #1117 King of May claim (not in this batch) is likely the same claim as PRED-333.G1; a later pass should check and join them as same. PRED-1118.E1 is registered 2026-01-18 although #1118 is a July 2026 deposit, presumably from the mantle's January origin date.

TJ09.6: the 4.3 passage of #1648 (AXN-06D6-text.md line 139) states the wager in other words ('The wager is that I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z does justify the title, for anyone who checks'); the 'one question the mantle puts' wording of #1681 is not in #1648 (search found no match). Both claims already sit in 'Prince of Poets wager'; nothing added.

TJ09.7: the apparent contradiction on the blog's span (PRED-87.D2 '2013–2023' against first-publication dates of October–December 2025 in the series members) is recorded, not resolved. PRED-87.D2 is left out of the first-publication series since it dates the blog as a whole, not a document's first publication.
TJ09.8: 'Ghost phrases that own their search result' now also carries PRED-596.B3 and PRED-49.G3. PRED-49.G3 is also in 'Immanent execution: the claim, its criteria and its tests'; it bears on both.

TJ09.10: PRED-134.D1 already carries F1615.D1 as a later statement; PRED-1679.D1 and PRED-1679.H3 left unlinked (different claims citing the same post). PRED-1679.D1 is placed in the first-publication series under TJ09.7.

TJ09.12: deposit #1636's front matter gives date 2014-07-06 and 'creator: Jack Feist; edited by Johannes Sigil'; #341 (lines 400-415) gives the Tiger Leap date as July 4, 2014 and names Sigil, not Feist, as author, calling the Feist-as-author listing a legacy misattribution. The #1636 creator field is in the form #341 calls for correction; the two-day date gap is not resolved. No set recorded.
